claims.result: no trend of Td with z
claims.finding: No evolution in dust temperature at constant LIR

evidence.quote: No evolution in the dust temperature at a fixed luminosity is seen in this redshift range.

evidence.quote: This fraction increases to $\sim$ 100 per cent at $M_\ast$ $\gtrsim$ 3 $\times$ 10$^{11}$ M$_{\odot}$
